⚇ narrowcasting: a multi-band narrative ( January 2026 ) ⚇

Agnes and I wrote an essay / technical document / manifesto / assemblage text called Narrowcasting thats just been published in Robida Collective’s new book Transmissions: Radio Essays on Edges, Crossings and Narrowcasting Borderlands. Available here!

⚇ low stakes high spirits ( December 2025 ) ⚇

Agnes and I performed a radio live set at St Giles Crypt Camberwell, as part of Low Stakes High Spirits! Thank you so much to the organisers and everyone who came!


⚇ noisy spaces at ucl slade ( November 2025 ) ⚇

I gave a lecture to UCL Slades Art & Technology and Mixed Media BA pathways, looking at noisy spaces, my practice and creative applications of mundane technology. I presented via figma board.


⚇ love rant - wind socks - our ponds - dyke project ( November 2025 ) ⚇

Agnes and I constructed a series of wind socks for the Our Ponds Dyke Project action at Hampstead Heath, with the slogans; Trans / Rights, Learn / Love & Our / Ponds. Additionally, I led a small piece called Love Rant, based on Julia Serano’s essay of the same name.


⚇ Switched-On: Goldberg - Holy Trinity NYC ( October 2025 ) ⚇

Agnes, myself and Austin Philamon performed the Goldberg Variations on a series of synthesisers inspired by the classic Switched-On: Bach by Wendy Carlos at the Holy Trinity Lutheran Chapel on Central Park West and 53rd Street as part of their legendary Bach Vespers programme.


⚇ !!!RADIO!!! - A Multi-Band Excitation Lecture - TWT 2025 ( October 2025 ) ⚇

Agnes and I presented an adapted lecture format of our piece Multi-Band Excitation at The World Transformed Festival 2025.


⚇ Start Up Sounds - LCLO ( October 2025 ) ⚇

I led a workshop as the London Community Laptop Orchestra at Bric Gallery Cafe, exploring the laptop as an instrument for performance. (I haven’t pictured the session due to privacy)


⚇ Multi-Band Excitation - Lumbung Radio ( September 2025 ) ⚇

I presented myself and Agnes’ installation piece Multi-Band Excitation at the Lumbung Radio Assembly as part of the 20 Days Of Commons festival in Berlin!


⚇ LCLO x PCO & Conducting! ( August 2025 ) ⚇

I led LCLO in a collaboration with artist Benji Jeffrey as part of PCO’s summer concert, performing his new work BCC! Also I conducted a full orchestra for the first time!


⚇ Midnight Gig in Topolò ( August 2025 ) ⚇

Agnes and I, performed a late night gig in Topolò as part of the Robida Academy of Margins public programme, by the old school, under a bright moon. Photo by Timo Kreuser


⚇ Multi-Band Excitation: A New Piece For Radio ( August 2025 ) ⚇

Agnes and I took part in Robida Collectives Academy of Margins, Radio Gardening Summer School, debuting our new piece, Multi-Band Excitation a workshop and discussion followed by a site-specific installation. A full write up of the piece is available here.
